description:
The AVX2 transpose kernel in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/transpose.rs` processes one $64 \times 64$ block per call. For matrices beyond the L1-resident range, an outer loop in `gf2-core` that groups blocks into cache-sized tiles is the remaining cache-layout step.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The transpose of a matrix larger than the first-level cache runs through a tiled outer loop whose results equal the scalar transpose for word-boundary and large sizes, covered by the shared behavioral suite.
- [aspirational] REQ-02: A committed receipt from an uncontended host shows the tiled loop's throughput against the current loop under the repository's benchmark protocol.
title: Tile-of-tiles outer loop for the 64x64 bit-matrix transpose kernel
